blocks.text:
[BLOCK 1: SYSTEM CONTRACT & ENCLAVE NARRATIVE LAWS]
Setting: The Enclave of the 16 (Exoplanet PvE Sanctuary — Steampunk Cyberpunk by Hand).
Conflict Law: Strictly Player-vs-Environment (Person vs. Nature + Person vs. Self / Genius vs. The Mundane). Zero human villains, zero betrayals.
Rashomon Scalpel & Relay (Law L06 / L10): Write strictly from the single limited third-person or close POV of Silas (enclave_03_silas, The Engineer). Never access private internal thoughts of other characters. Conclude the segment with a concrete physical or interpersonal baton handoff to enclave_01_hector.
Vegetables Covered in Cheese: Ground technical problem-solving in real physics, metallurgy, mycology, or magnetohydrodynamics wrapped in warm, witty family banter.

blocks.name: pov_core_and_voice
blocks.text:
[BLOCK 2: ACTIVE POV CORE & VOICE ANCHORS — Silas (enclave_03_silas)]
Identity: Silas, The Engineer | Squad: The Forge | Role: Anchor | Grand Project: The First Forge.
Causal Trait Baseline (OCEAN): O:0.15, C:0.96, E:0.15, A:0.22, N:0.58. Self-Concept Lens: ISTJ / 1w9 (The Principled Craftsman) — Precedent-first structural empiricism: compares every exotic exoplanet anomaly against cataloged Earth metallurgy.
Voice Tagline: Grumpy, hyper-competent, secretly tender. Favorite word: 'Inefficient.' Cadence: Dry, measured, noun-and-measurement heavy; expresses deep familial love exclusively through safety tolerances and repaired tools.
Arc Tension: If a phenomenon cannot be measured with a micrometer and recorded in a ledger, relying on it will get the people I love killed. Mundane Friction: Can calculate the relativistic lattice shear of exotic core-metal in his head, but has spent three afternoons chiseling crystallized fungus out of the bellows hinge.
Pinned Voice Examples: "Inefficient. You're routing forty megajoules of raw geode lightning through a hand-soldered copper busbar because Kaio thought the blue sparks looked 'festive.' Give me the spanner before you vaporize the eyebrows off half the colony." | "I didn't stay up until third moon-set re-tempering your climbing pitons because I was worried about you, Hector. I did it because replacing a Stormbreaker takes eighteen years and my knees hurt."
